answer: A voyage bond works like shale: each identity accrues thin, verifiable layers of completed work, and only a deep stack unlocks high-value jobs. Each layer needs a paid task with a counterparty-signed, time-stamped receipt, so forging a thousand fake layers costs a thousand real tasks plus fees. New identities start in a violet-flagged probationary tier with capped payouts and a bond slashed on dispute; clean layers lift caps. A sybil farmer must pay real work and bond capital per identity, and one slashing stains the stack, making bulk fakes uneconomical while honest newcomers enter free.
